visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a beanie and a navy green windbreaker sits on a white couch, laughing while looking at his smartphone. Behind him is a warm floor lamp. (2) A person with long brown hair (wearing a wig) and a blue plaid shirt sits beside him, holding a law textbook and eyeing the man's phone suspiciously. (3) The man looks back, and they engage in a high-energy comedic argument with exaggerated facial expressions and hand gestures. (4) The man abruptly presents a purple box and small bottles of Brand's Lutein Essence against a plain white background, holding up two fingers to emphasize a point. (5) The long-haired character drinks from the bottle and smiles with satisfaction, looking rejuvenated. (6) A man appearing as a futuristic figure in a silver quilted vest and clear goggles stands in a bright room, gesturing towards the camera while holding the product box. (7) The original man gives the long-haired character a box and small packets of Lutein Jelly as they exit through a white door. (8) The man smiles at his phone alone, followed by a split-screen or quick cut showing the futuristic man also looking at his phone, revealing a hidden connection. (9) The final shot shows the long-haired character walking outdoors in a park, eating the jelly packet while looking bright-eyed.
